caption:
New term, more rehearsals, and Momo's hips and arches are already letting her know.

Turnout, jumps and time on demi-pointe load the deep hip muscles, calves and the small muscles under the foot. Many dancers find remedial massage helps those areas feel less tight and heavy through a busy term.

Massage sits alongside strength work, good technique and rest, not instead of them. Keep deeper sessions for lighter days, and look after your feet at home with a ball, slow calf raises and toe spreads. Pain on top of the foot that builds with jumping is worth a physio assessment.
